name: desktop
description: Real-time chat application with messaging, calls, and communities

scripts.package: pnpm build:web && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml && node scripts/package-release.mjs
scripts.package:linux: pnpm build:web && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux && node scripts/package-release.mjs linux
scripts.package:mac: pnpm build:web && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac && node scripts/package-release.mjs darwin
scripts.package:win: pnpm build:web && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win && node scripts/package-release.mjs win32
scripts.package:all: pnpm build:web && pnpm build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --mac --win
